name: Minimal Missing Support Does Not Bound Separation Margin
statement: There is no function $g$ with $g(2)>0$ such that every convex-realizable maximum learning space $C$ satisfies $\mu(C)\ge g(r(C))$, where $r(C)$ is the largest support size of a minimal missing pattern.
proof: The prefix-chain threshold classes $T_h$ are convex-realizable maximum learning spaces with $r(T_h)=2$ and positive separation margin at most $1/h$. Letting $h$ grow rules out any positive lower bound depending only on $r=2$.
